title: callicarpa pentandra f. surigaensis
intro: Callicarpa pentandra f. surigaensis, commonly known as the Philippine purple callicarpa, is a plant species that belongs to the family Lamiaceae. The health benefits of Callicarpa pentandra f. surigaensis include its use in treating fever and inflammation due to its analgesic and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory activities. The bioactive constituents of Callicarpa pentandra f. surigaensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
